files.reason: Inspected standard-unit resolution, finite and bucket-order validation, half/full triangular weight with 1e-10 width floor, bump constructors and market-target dispatch data; later cfg(test) modules are tests only.
Inspected per-variant roll and bump dispatch, spread-risk selection for hazards, ID-preserving reconstruction, unchanged correlation on roll, and unsupported basis/parametric bump branches.
Inspected exact typed curve lookup, Price versus VolIndex kind discrimination, missing/wrong-type errors, and dedicated surface/index namespaces; no nearest-ID fallback.
Inspected replacement/insertion semantics, canonical credit-index reference rebinding, reference-state construction and credit-composite invalidation trigger.
Inspected same-currency FX bypass, dated default-policy rate conversion, canonical composite rebinding, failed-composite removal, and map/namespace ownership.
Inspected ordered copy-on-write batch composition, namespace precedence, FX percent conversion, decimal scratch-price bump, saved-state/node reversion and credit rebinding.
Inspected all-or-error rolling of curve namespace only; FX, surface expiries, observations and dividends remain copied; composites rebind after rolling.
Inspected deterministic snapshots, per-namespace duplicate-ID rejection, typed composite-reference checks, quote-only FX restoration and versioned versus typed load paths.
Inspected counts/iteration plus material retain-curves rebinding/invalidation, direct surface/cube replacement and combined clearing of scalar/series/index/dividend namespaces.
Inspected baseline-grid sampling, unweighted/equality-tolerant shift averaging, per-tenor differences, credit/inflation source dispatch, raw-print selection and FX/scalar unit-sensitive changes.
Inspected event sorting and cash/yield/stock-ratio domain checks, optional schedule currency, duplicate-date retention and validating wire reconstruction; no dividend PV kernel exists here.
Inspected exact-date historical fixing enforcement, missing-series diagnostics and CMS tenor-to-ID rounding; as_of is diagnostic rather than lookup eligibility control.
Inspected slash-path creation, first-error retention, target-node tagging/curve assignment and final hierarchy validation.
Inspected path validation, globally unique stored curve-ID rule, node traversal and validating hierarchy deserialization; existence in MarketContext is not checked.
Inspected local tag predicates, subtree expansion, overlap duplication, matched-depth ranking and MostSpecificWins versus Cumulative selection.
Inspected module declarations only; exposes bumps/context/diff/dividends/fixings/hierarchy/scalars/surfaces/term-structures/traits and contains no numerical or selection implementation.
Inspected calendar-month/day lags, exact-month observation resolution, contract-month day weights, seasonality multiplication, publication metadata and ratio domain behavior.
Inspected private-module declarations and public re-exports of scalar/series/inflation types; no additional computation or defaults.
Inspected runtime after early cfg(test) import: finite scalar/series construction, sorted dates, Step/Linear/Exact/monthly lookup, right-tail carry, checked money and standard series shocks.
Inspected aligned expiry/quote dimensions, paired 10-delta controls and arithmetic ATM+BF+/-RR/2 wing positivity; no strike inversion exists in this file.
Inspected re-exports and shared validate_axis kernel: nonempty finite increasing axes with singleton support; materially governs every surface/cube constructor.
Inspected parameter bounds including nu=0, strict rho endpoints, optional finite signed shift and validating wire conversion.
Inspected positive expiry/tenor grids, row-major dimensions, finite forward domain, checked node addressing and selectable Vol/TotalVariance metadata; evaluation belongs to models.
Inspected fixed-expiry tenor/strike grid validation, nonnegative quotes, quote convention and one shifted-Black displacement per tenor row, including wire reconstruction.
Inspected quote/axis/interpolation controls, grid and displacement validation, floored parallel/bucket/node shocks, nearest-node selection and tolerance matching.
Inspected fixed linear/flat detachment interpolation, [0,100]/[0,1] units and domains, nonblocking shape diagnostics, bucket matching and clamped shocks.
Inspected signed-level interpolation selection, default flat endpoint spreads, shared source-preserving roll state and rebuilding when negative cumulative offset drops that state.
Inspected merged piecewise-linear coefficients, exact segment integration with Neumaier summation, zero-rate derivative versus forward-rate shocks and scaling validation.
Inspected declarations/re-exports of adjustment and roll helpers only; kernels are covered in their own assigned files.
Inspected retained-source offsets, pillar-consistency tolerance, negative-offset state dropping, shock-origin reinsertion and strictly-positive remaining-knot filtering.
Inspected complete constituent coverage, finite/nonnegative unit-sum weights, recovery override domains and unknown-issuer aggregate/equal-weight fallbacks.
Inspected sorted DF ingestion, exact origin, calendar validation, named/raw validation modes, original-source interpolator construction and transformed-pillar consistency.
Inspected flat/from-rates/from-dates constructors, zero/continuous-forward/date queries, day-count/calendar mapping, metadata controls and sampled simple-forward conversion.
Inspected source-DF normalization, offset-adjustment integral formula, exact origin, offset validation and restored public-pillar consistency.
Inspected default minimum-forward tenor, calendar resolution, validated wire representation including transform/rate recipe and raw validation controls; inline tests follow production.
Inspected pure Discounting adapter forwarding ID/base/DF/day count/calendar to DiscountCurve; no distinct numerical kernel or policy selection beyond that delegation.
Inspected continuous zero-rate shock state, pillar/peak finite positivity checks, stress-policy relaxation, normalized curve rolling and expiry failure.
Inspected preset parsing, negative-rate floor checks, nonincreasing pillar tolerance and adjacent log-DF forward validation; raw setter control values are not fully constrained.
Inspected finite positive tenor/nonnegative reset lag, forward knots and contractual projection grid validation, excluded MonotoneConvex and retained-source transform reconstruction.
Inspected identifier normalization/substrings, recognized currency fallbacks, day-count precedence and overnight versus term reset-lag inference.
Inspected point rates, clamped date clock, contractual-period growth, numeric/grid projection log-DF loop and fixed-panel Simpson averages with exact adjustment area.
Inspected shifted/scaled source-rate formula, additive versus multiplicative shock composition, unsupported multiplicative buckets and transform consistency validation.
Inspected field declarations/imports and all module/re-export declarations, including transform and wire after cfg(test) mod tests; defaults/algorithms are in builder/curve/conventions.
Inspected dedicated tests and fixtures only: compounded-growth formulas, numerical tenor versus contractual grid, fixed average semantics, shocks/rolls, inferred conventions and recipe serde.
Inspected metadata rebuild, projection-grid extension, continuous shock updates and offset/grid rolling; replacement knots discard transform while preserving recipe.
Inspected serialization of projection grid/conventions/recipe/transform and validating reconstruction through the builder; transport preserves calculation controls.
Inspected sorted positive point data, ordered interval-end data, linear versus right-continuous step selection, flat tails and nonfinite-query NaN.
Inspected deterministic independent input sorting, supported quote-type checks, strictly increasing pillar times and matching original/risk quote IDs; opaque JSON remains consumer-validated.
Inspected explicit recovery, hazard cap/nonnegative rates, sorted ending knots, weaker par-quote validation and strict log-linear survival construction.
Inspected ending-segment hazard lookup, cumulative survival, local conditional-default integration, survival-probability inversion and quoted/log-fallback/triangle CDS spread lookup.
Inspected default hazard cap 10/year, default Linear par interpolation, bump-target enum and metadata, plus transform/wire declarations after test module declaration.

Inspected dedicated fixture/assertion file: survival derivatives, boundaries, tiny and underflowed conditional PD, recovery-scaled versus direct hazards, segment targeting, atomicity and recipe invalidation.
Inspected recovery override, spread-to-hazard approximation, knot/tenor shock domains and selection, quote/recipe invalidation and conditional-survival rolling.
Inspected default cap/par-interpolation restoration and validated reconstruction of hazards, recovery, quote metadata and replay recipe.
Inspected positive projected CPI anchors, months/12 lag, CAGR/index ratio, gross-factor shocks, source-preserving roll and wire domain validation.
Inspected module declarations and public/internal re-exports only; the listed owning implementation files contain all financial choices.
Inspected NS/NSS basis formulas, parameter validation, analytic forwards versus trait adapter, source-DF-ratio rolling and nonpositive-time/offset boundaries.
Inspected signed/vol-index domains, spot anchoring, interpolation/tails, unit-specific parallel/local shocks, source-preserving and backward roll rules and validated wire kind inference.
Inspected financially material bootstrap/global-solve, OIS observation/compounding, curve-role and quote-convention recipe types; no inverse calibration kernel is implemented in this file.
Inspected relative DF ratio/date conversion, positive finite checks and generic adaptive-epsilon finite-difference instantaneous forward, including equal-endpoint shortcut.
